entities.summary: Idrottsparken is a multi-purpose stadium in Sundsvall, Sweden. It was opened on 6 August 1903. It is currently used mostly for football matches and is the home stadium of GIF Sundsvall and Sundsvalls DFF. The stadium holds 8,000 people during football matches.
